# apple_game_center_activity (Resource)

Creates a Game Center activity, which links players to a part of the game, for an app or for a group of apps. Link achievements and leaderboards with `apple_game_center_activity_achievement` and `apple_game_center_activity_leaderboard`, add its name with `apple_game_center_activity_localization` and its images with `apple_game_center_activity_default_image` and `apple_game_center_activity_image`, then submit it with `apple_submit_game_center_activity`. `fallback_url` belongs to the version being prepared, so changing it once the current version has been reviewed starts the next one. Destroying the resource deletes the activity; one that has been live can't be deleted, so it is archived instead. Import it by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_game_center_activity" "example" {
  game_center_detail_id = apple_game_center_detail.example.id
  reference_name        = "Daily puzzle"
  vendor_identifier     = "com.example.daily_puzzle"
  play_style            = "ASYNCHRONOUS"
  minimum_players_count = 1
  maximum_players_count = 4
  fallback_url          = "https://example.com/daily"
  properties            = { level = "daily" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `reference_name` (String) Name of the activity in App Store Connect.
- `vendor_identifier` (String) Identifier the game knows the activity by, e.g. `com.example.daily_puzzle`. Changing it creates a new activity.

### Optional

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the activity is archived, which hides it from players. Defaults to `false`.
- `fallback_url` (String) URL that opens when the game isn't installed or doesn't handle the activity.
- `game_center_detail_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app's Game Center detail, e.g. `apple_game_center_detail.example.id`. Set this or `game_center_group_id`.
- `game_center_group_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of a Game Center group, for an activity its apps share. Set this or `game_center_detail_id`.
- `maximum_players_count` (Number) Most players the activity takes.
- `minimum_players_count` (Number) Fewest players the activity takes.
- `play_style` (String) How players take part: `ASYNCHRONOUS`, `SYNCHRONOUS`. Unset keeps App Store Connect's value.
- `properties` (Map of String) Properties passed to the game when a player opens the activity.
- `supports_party_code` (Boolean) Whether players can join with a party code. Unset keeps App Store Connect's value.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the Game Center activity.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_game_center_activity.example
  identity = {
    id = "1d3f5a7c-9b2e-4c6d-8a0f-2b4c6d8e0f1a"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the Game Center activity.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_game_center_activity.example 1d3f5a7c-9b2e-4c6d-8a0f-2b4c6d8e0f1a
```
